‘Ma, they punched me’: Student’s last call to family; how horror unfolded at homestay
articles.description: Nimisha Thakuria, a 22-year-old Gauhati University student, made a frantic phone call stating she could not breathe. After her family lost contact, she was found critically injured at a homestay on the outskirts of Guwahati. Her alleged companion, Ashiq Ali, has been detained, stating that she hanged herself. Local residents have protested for a thorough investigation, linking the incident to broader societal issues.

articles.title: Former Keralam chief secretary Jiji Thomson alleges Gyanesh Kumar suggested BJP ticket
articles.description: Jiji Thomson, a former chief secretary, revealed that Gyanesh Kumar suggested he join the BJP. The proposal occurred during a flight to New Delhi in 2016. Kumar mentioned that Thomson could become a Union minister if elected. Thomson, however, declined the suggestion, expressing disinterest in politics. He has been approached by various political leaders in the past regarding electoral positions.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs summoned by Australia Senate over AI agent breach
articles.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have received written requests to appear at a public hearing in Canberra on Thursday, according to a spokesperson for Senator Sarah Hanson-Young, the Australian Greens lawmaker chairing the inquiry. Neither company immediately responded to requests for comment outside business hours. Earlier, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese described the breach as “unacceptable”.

articles.title: Winds, floods, 20-foot waves: What’s behind the nor’easter battering US East Coast
articles.description: A powerful nor’easter is currently disrupting life on the US East Coast, delivering heavy rainfall and fierce winds. More than 100,000 households are without power due to downed trees and lines. Air travel has come to a standstill with numerous cancellations and delays across airports. Coastal regions are on alert for possible flooding from exceptionally high tides, while emergency teams remain on standby for further challenges as the storm unfolds.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Vishal suffers back injury during Purushan climax shoot in Goa
articles.description: During an action shoot for 'Purushan' in Goa, actor Vishal suffered a back injury that requires immediate medical attention. Doctors have prescribed a recovery period of three weeks, leading to his disappointment as he will miss the important Nadigar Sangam general body meeting. Grateful for the outpouring of support from fans, Vishal is eager to heal swiftly and return to his film duties and organizational commitments.

articles.title: Mohanlal's organic garden at his Elamakkara home
articles.description: Mohanlal, the renowned actor, has nurturing an organic vegetable garden at his Elamakkara home in Kochi for years. During the 2021 lockdown, he engaged fans by sharing videos of his gardening endeavors, showcasing that even small spaces can yield fresh produce with methods like grow bags. This variety includes vegetables used in everyday cooking, all while he juggles his thriving acting career with his passion for sustainable farming.

articles.title: 'Nikhila Vimal': 'Coming with ten cameras is difficult for me'
articles.description: Nikhila Vimal has shared her discomfort regarding unexpected camera interactions while promoting her film 'Dhoomakethu'. She clarified that her reactions are based on her personal feelings and not directed at journalists. The actress prefers scheduled press meets where she feels more prepared and comfortable. Nikhila acknowledged the need for media content but finds sudden questions challenging to handle. 'Dhoomakethu' has been well-received, highlighting various contemporary social themes throughout its narrative.
